Instrument (EN): Moral–Civic Identity Scale — 14-item original German two-factor youth identity measure
Question count: 14 final (7 moral; 7 civic). Original 27 candidate trait prompts included 9 distractors.
Scales / measured domains (EN): Moral identity (7); Civic / democratic value identity (7). Correlated factors rather than diagnostic symptom score.
Research provenance: Wilke J, von Düring U, Zumbach-Basu J. Discover Psychology 6:290; published 2026-10-21, DOI 10.1007/s44202-026-00951-w. Cross-sectional online German-speaking Germany and Swiss youth N1149 ages16–27; 27 initial traits, 14 retained after CFA and theoretical item review; residence and gender measurement invariance evidence.

Instrument (EN): Prosocial Job Crafting Measure — 12-item original three-domain occupational measure
Scales / measured domains (EN): Task prosocial job crafting; Relational prosocial job crafting; Cognitive prosocial job crafting. Distinct occupational behaviors, not psychiatric symptoms.
Research provenance: Viragos A, Davis MC, Leach DJ. Putting others first: testing a model of prosociality and performance. Journal of Business and Psychology; published 2026-10-15, DOI 10.1007/s10869-026-10160-w. Study1 US employees N500 (EFA 200, CFA 300); Study2 Hungarian academic library workers N262 with 8 supervisor performance ratings. Final 12 items in article appendix, 3 factors; second study alpha about .79/.73/.80.

Instrument (EN): Food Literacy BITE Scale — final 18-item child-centered food literacy instrument
Question count: 18 final (20 after expert review, 2 removed for cross-loading)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Food system and nutrition knowledge; Confidence in everyday food skills; Valuing shared food experiences; Purposeful engagement with food. Four first-order factors plus higher-order literacy.
Research provenance: St. Pierre C, Bingenheimer JB, van Dam RM, Sacheck JM. Nutrition Journal; published 2026-10-21, DOI 10.1186/s12937-026-01413-8. Expert panel n10, cognitive interviews n43 grade4/5, field CFA N690 children across 10 US schools. Four-factor model CFI .96, TLI .95, RMSEA .046, SRMR .051. Composite reliability overall .74; factors .62–.71.
